title: A host lead's funnel origin (region, area, channel, source, utm tags) is visible on the CRM contact and filterable

source.ref: Meta scan 2026-11-09 evening (Daniel, 'missing controls or surfaces'). /start/host (LIVE-2233) writes contacts.meta.funnel and meta.lead_source on every lead, and no admin or CRM surface reads either, so the origin FlowWeb tags every invite with cannot be seen or used to segment.

detail: Found 2026-11-10. captureLead stores contacts.meta.funnel (persona, region, area, channel, src, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign) and meta.lead_source. Nothing under app/(main)/admin, components/frequency/admin or lib/crm reads them, so an operator cannot see which invite or town a host came from, and the Founding Member and host campaigns cannot be segmented by it. Fix: show the origin on the contact detail pane (kit rows, no hand-rolled markup) and add a Source facet to the contacts roster filter, composing the existing facet registry. Verify probe fails today because no CRM file mentions the funnel meta.
